text:
sara (support): Heads-up: multiple customers reporting a spike in 5xx / timeouts on hosted API since ~10:12 UTC. Support started a thread with logs and a repro. Attaching quick summary and metric snips.

support-bot: ALERT hosted-gateway-high-5xx: rate=6.4% (5m), p99 latency=12.4s, affected region=us-west-2, affected service=gateway-hosted.

sara (support): Customer example: tenant=acme-inc, started seeing 504s at 10:10, traces show requests hitting enqueue + waiting >10s then timing out. They provided a short curl repro.

logs pasted by sara (support):
```
[2026-03-17T10:12:08Z] hosted-gateway INFO enqueue request tenant=acme-inc id=abc123
[2026-03-17T10:12:20Z] hosted-gateway ERROR enqueue failed: queue_full tenant=acme-inc depth=20001 max_depth=20000
[2026-03-17T10:12:20Z] continuous-batcher WARN backlog_size=8920 avg_batch_latency_ms=1234
[2026-03-17T10:12:22Z] gateway ERROR downstream timeout id=abc123 status=504
```

kevin (oncall): I'm on it. Initial hypothesis: continuous batching backlog + request queue saturation causing huge tail waits -> gateway 504s. Any deploys around 10:00-10:10?

anika (eng): There was a runtime rollout at 09:58 that changed batcher tuning (increased batch window default). Might be related. Rolling back that change is an option but let's try less disruptive mitigations first.

kevin (oncall): Good catch. Quick mitigations we'll try in order: 1) enable early-reject for tenants that exceed per-tenant queue fraction 2) temporarily reduce batch window to 40ms for hosted pool 3) scale up gateway instances in us-west-2 by 2 nodes 4) make a tenant-specific throttling rule for acme-inc. I'll run the playbook.

kevin (oncall): /runplaybook mitigate-ingress-queue --region us-west-2 --scale +2 --enable-early-reject=true

infra-bot: playbook started: mitigate-ingress-queue id=pb-98765 by kevin. Steps: scale_pool, set_early_reject, adjust_batcher.

dennis (ml): If backlog is in continuous-batcher, we should also inspect kv-cache pressure; long KV fill times can increase batch assembly latency. Pulling kv metrics now.

anika (eng): Patch to reduce max_batch_latency_ms applied to hosted batcher config:
```
continuous_batcher:
  max_batch_latency_ms: 40
  max_backlog_items: 5000
```
applied to pool hosted-us-west-2 by anika at 10:18.

kevin (oncall): Early-reject enabled (threshold=0.98). Also added a temporary per-tenant queue cap: acme-inc max_depth=5000. Monitoring.

sara (support): Notified acme-inc that we're investigating and applying mitigations. They asked for ETA on fix.

ops (lead): Good. Prioritize customer comms and get a rollback path ready. Also capture metrics every 30s for the next 10m.

infra-bot: scale_pool completed: +2 instances (gw-12, gw-13). set_early_reject completed. update_config completed.

support-bot: METRIC hosted-gateway 1m: 5xx_rate=1.8% p99=1.3s (10:25 UTC)

kevin (oncall): Early signs promising. 5xx dropped from 6.4% -> 1.8%. Continuous-batcher backlog trending down from 8920 -> 1200.

dennis (ml): KV cache latency was elevated (p95 200ms -> 1.2s) during the spike. Looks like memory pressure caused slower cache fills, contributing to batch assembly delays. Noting for postmortem.

anika (eng): I'm reverting the runtime batching change on a separate canary lane to validate. If revert is safe, we'll rollback the tuning that increased batch window.

kevin (oncall): Can we confirm whether the initial failures were dominated by a few tenants or broad? Metrics show two tenants with >60% of rejects: acme-inc and beta-qa.

sara (support): Confirmed from customer reports: acme-inc showed most. Beta-qa hits are small customers but noisy.

kevin (oncall): Next steps: keep per-tenant caps for 1h, watch for regressions. Create follow-up ticket to: 1) add per-tenant queue visibility in console 2) lower default max_depth to prevent global saturation 3) tighter alerting on batcher backlog growth.

anika (eng): Revert patch applied at 10:36 to canary pools. If green for 10m then full rollback.

support-bot: NOTE customer acme-inc responded: "Thanks, saw errors subside around 10:26, app seems healthy now" :thumbsup:

kevin (oncall): Full rollback of batching-change completed at 10:46. Metrics stable. We'll leave early-reject in place for 1 hour then evaluate.

ops (lead): Filing incident follow-up: INCIDENT-20260317-01. Own: anika (eng). SRE actions: add per-tenant max queue metric, create alert when continuous-batcher backlog > 2500 for 2m.

sara (support): Customer communicated and asked for root cause summary. I'll draft a short customer-friendly explanation and coordinate with anika for technical details.

anika (eng): Quick notes for postmortem: root cause triangle = (1) batching tuning increased batch window -> larger batch assembly windows (2) KV cache pressure slowed batch completion (3) default global queue depth allowed backlog to grow until early-reject kicked in. Mitigations = early-reject, scale-up, batch window revert, per-tenant caps.

kevin (oncall): Closing Slack thread for now. If anything flares, ping me directly. Thanks team. :heart:
